name: Brenhines-y-Nef

attributes.attribute: an ancient and obscure sky goddess

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Brenhines-y-Nef is a Welsh goddess. She is an ancient and obscure sky goddess. She also acts as a maternal force. The Welsh held her to be an ancestral mother of all humanity.

okr.objective: Describe Brenhines-y-Nef, the ancient Welsh sky goddess.
key_results: She was an ancient and obscure sky goddess.
She served as a maternal force.
The Welsh saw her as an ancestral mother of humanity.
